name: India (Naval Ensign)
description: A white field with the Indian tricolor in the canton and, toward the fly, a navy octagon bordered in gold enclosing the naval crest.
history: The ensign adopted in September 2022, replacing the St George's cross with an octagonal crest drawn from Shivaji's maritime seal.

features.role: octagonal crest of the Indian Navy
features.symbolism: the octagon recalls the seal of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's navy
